_comment: All three identities author with the GitHub noreply address for user 132381941 (Roy-Mutwiri), so every commit binds to that account and counts toward the contribution graph. The display names stay distinct, so `git log --author` and the commit subjects still separate Anon / Dripper / shared work. The noreply form keeps the owner's real email out of this repo's public history - do NOT replace it with a routable personal address.
